wikipedia.title: Hooper Solar PV Power Plant
wikipedia.extract: The Hooper Solar PV Power Plant is a 50 megawatt (MWAC) photovoltaic power station in the San Luis Valley, located near the town of Mosca, Colorado.   It was the largest solar facility in the state when it came online at the end of 2015.   The electricity is being sold to Public Service of Colorado, a subsidiary of Xcel Energy, under a long-term power purchase agreement.
